> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR

> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **3** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **215** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **155** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **155**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **100** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **17** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f09d4122bc8c2eb39414b83b1924217a04b66cb2` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `b38aad98721650728760092cffe64646b1bc48d0` — the merge of head `2bd379d22a84715c722a45510d0a9255fa9b3d16` into base `f09d4122bc8c2eb39414b83b1924217a04b66cb2`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin b38aad98721650728760092cffe64646b1bc48d0 && git checkout b38aad98721650728760092cffe64646b1bc48d0
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin f09d4122bc8c2eb39414b83b1924217a04b66cb2 2bd379d22a84715c722a45510d0a9255fa9b3d16 && git checkout -B drift-repro f09d4122bc8c2eb39414b83b1924217a04b66cb2 && git merge --no-ff 2bd379d22a84715c722a45510d0a9255fa9b3d16

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f09d4122bc8c2eb39414b83b1924217a04b66cb2
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs f09d4122bc8c2eb39414b83b1924217a04b66cb2` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `aa923a1f5c4679d32b73bd784e8f8f3a3ba3e89f`

Scope: 4 files (+561/−2) on merge base `a08e059c61`:
- `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`, `lowerWhereFilterArray` only: an import, three module-private helpers, the gate, and the array branch's envelope;
- a unit pin and a dogfood pin;
- `.changeset/20121-engine-where-shape-refused.md`.

Measured in detached worktrees at head and base, through a real `ObjectQL` on `InMemoryDriver` and `SqlDriver` (better-sqlite3), with 4 rows seeded (2 per owner). Driver verbs were wrapped to count calls, and rows were read back past the engine. The three security legs were: no `SecurityPlugin`; `SecurityPlugin` under a system context; and an RLS-scoped member. That makes 900 cells per tree.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The defect at base: confirmed, whole table.** On both drivers, without `SecurityPlugin` and with it under a system context, for a string, `42`, `Map`, `Date`, `Set`, `true` and `''`:
  - `find` returned all 4 rows, `count` 4, and `aggregate` one group of 4;
  - `findOne` returned the first row (for `Map`, `Date` and `Set`, the no-predicate refusal, with no `code`);
  - `update(multi)` rewrote **4 of 4** rows and `delete(multi)` deleted **4 of 4**: 28 of 28 write cells on those legs.
  - `[1,2,3]` was refused with `code`, `status` and `httpStatus` all undefined.
- **An RLS-scoped member at base:**
  - A string, number, `Map`, `Date`, `Set` or `true` was refused by the DRIVER after the middleware's `$and` composition, with 0 rows.
  - **`''` was not refused.** The composition (`security-plugin.ts`, `opCtx.ast.where ? { $and: … } : …`) drops a falsy `where`, so `find` answered all 2 of the member's rows, and `update(multi)` / `delete(multi)` rewrote or deleted them: every row the member could reach.
- **The unscoped-write guard:** at base, `''`, a string, a number and a `Map` stepped past a `where === undefined || null` guard and the write touched 4 of 4. At head these are refused before the guard runs.
- **Head:** 288 of 288 bad cells (6 legs × 6 verbs × 8 shapes) are `INVALID_FILTER`, `status` 400, `httpStatus` 400, with the `VERB('deal')` prefix, **0 driver calls and 0 rows**, including the member's `''` cells.
- **Accept set:** 324 of 324 cells are byte-identical to base in outcome, rows, `code`, `status`, message and driver calls. The shapes were absent, `undefined`, `null`, `{}`, `[]`, `Object.create(null)` with a filter, a class instance with a filter, a plain filter and a FilterArray. A `Proxy` of a filter, a frozen filter and objects from another `vm` realm are unchanged too. SDK builders produce arrays or plain objects, and the REST parser produces a plain object.
- **A legitimate shape the gate now refuses:** an object carrying `Symbol.toStringTag`, as an own key or through a prototype getter. It filtered correctly at base (2 / 2 / 2) and is refused at head (`received Criteria`). Nothing in the repo produces it: the wire is JSON, the SDK produces arrays or plain objects, and the census below found none.
- **Census:** 0 shipped callers pass a string, number, boolean or `new` literal as `where` to the six verbs (control: 126 sites pass `where: {`).
- **REST, byte-identical at base and head:** `GET ?filter=` / `?where=` with these shapes is refused 400 `INVALID_FILTER` at the wire normalizer, and `POST …/query` with them is refused 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` by Zod. No HTTP door reaches the engine seam with them, so the head's change is in-process only.
- **The pins discriminate.**
  - Gate → `if (false)`: 24 failed, 23 passed (47).
  - Array branch → `new Error(`: 6 failed, 41 passed (47).
  - The dogfood pin against the base dist: 8 failed, 2 passed. At head: 10 passed.
  - Restored by blob.
- **Message:** the wire door's words, with a per-verb consequence clause. The `[1,2,3]` message is unchanged. `invalidFilterError` and `INVALID_FILTER` already exist, and there is no new export.
- **Scope: RIGHT.** The `having` region, draft PR #20125's docblock, the drivers and REST are untouched. `git merge-tree` against `f09d4122bc` is clean.
- **CI at this head:** 35 runs, 32 `success`, 3 `skipped`, 0 failed and 0 pending. All required contexts are `success`.

### ② Semver level

`Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `@objectstack/objectql` `minor`, BREAKING, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`: RIGHT.
- It adds no export and no type member, and the narrowing is BREAKING. This matches the PR #20138 precedent.
- `check-changeset-no-major --event <PR body>`: "✓ This diff introduces no `major` bump." and "✓ LEVEL AXIS: … `no (narrowing)` …" (exit 0).
- `check-adr-0087-registration`: "✓ 1 declared-breaking changeset(s), each carrying an ADR-0087 disposition." (exit 0).

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Changeset: two FALSE sentences.**
  1. "For a caller scoped by row-level security, the security middleware wrapped the value into its `$and`, where the driver refused it (`INVALID_FILTER`) and nothing was written." This is FALSE for `''`: the composition dropped it as absent, and the member's every reachable row was rewritten or deleted.
  2. "A filter object is accepted whatever its prototype …" This is FALSE for an object carrying `Symbol.toStringTag`, own or inherited: it filtered correctly at base and is refused at head.
- **PR body, imprecise:** "The prototype is not checked". The built-in tag is read through the prototype chain.
- Every other changeset and body sentence holds against the head.

Reviewed-by: `session_01Bvd69VPa6puiNzzPUroDBx`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

Must-change (prose only; `engine.ts` blob `4f5d28170b`, both pins and the declaration need no change):
1. `.changeset/20121-engine-where-shape-refused.md`, "What it replaces": qualify the RLS sentence. The driver refused a string, number, `Map`, `Date`, `Set` or `true` after the `$and` composition, but the composition dropped the empty string as absent, and every row the member could reach was rewritten or deleted.
2. Same file, "Unchanged": replace "whatever its prototype" with the real accept condition: a non-array object whose built-in tag is `[object Object]` (a plain object, `Object.create(null)`, a class instance, a Proxy, an object from another realm). An object that overrides `Symbol.toStringTag` is refused and named by its tag.
3. (should) PR body: "The prototype is not checked" → the tag is read through the prototype chain.

Head-sha: `2bd379d22a84715c722a45510d0a9255fa9b3d16`

Scope: a DELTA review of PR #20144 after FAIL 5831634153 on `aa923a1f5c`. **This record supersedes that FAIL on the prose.** There is one new commit, `2bd379d22a`, which touches only `.changeset/20121-engine-where-shape-refused.md` (+23/−7).

### ① Derived judgments

- **Blob identity, verified by the reviewer:**
  - `engine.ts` is `4f5d28170b`, `engine-where-shape-refusal.test.ts` is `285177d8cb` and the dogfood pin is `a7b7b4892f`, all the same as `aa923a1f5c`.
  - The 900-cell readings, both ablations (24/23 and 6/41 of 47), the dogfood pin (8 failed, 2 passed at base; 10 passed at head) and the REST readings in 5831634153 carry over unchanged.
- **Must-change 1, the RLS sentence split by value: TRUE.**
  - A string, number, `Map`, `Date`, `Set` or `true` was refused by the driver after the `$and` composition.
  - The empty string was dropped as absent, and the member's every reachable row was rewritten or deleted: 2 of 4 on both drivers, matching the base readings.
- **Must-change 2, the accept condition: TRUE.**
  - A non-array object whose built-in tag is `[object Object]` is accepted: a plain object, `Object.create(null)`, a class instance, a `Proxy`, or an object from another realm. Each of these is byte-identical at base and head on all six legs.
  - An object that overrides `Symbol.toStringTag`, own or inherited, is refused and named by its tag. It filtered correctly at base, and no in-repo producer creates one.
- **Must-change 3, the PR body: done.** "The prototype is not checked" is gone, and the tag is read through the prototype chain. The H4 table gains the `Symbol.toStringTag` row.
- **No new FALSE sentence** in the whole new changeset or the whole new body. Two precision nits, not false:
  - For `findOne` with `Map`, `Date` or `Set`, the engine's own no-predicate guard refuses first, as the changeset already states.
  - Under RLS at base, the variant with an inherited tag was already refused by the driver.
- `git merge-tree` against `origin/main` `f09d4122bc` is clean.

Unchanged: `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `@objectstack/objectql` `minor`, BREAKING, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

- The dev has no open questions. The two out-of-scope notes stand as measured in 5831634153. The per-aggregation `filter` string drop folds into the #20122 combined claim once this PR lands.
